ID: `avoid-ai-writing`.

## What it does

Reads the text and looks for filler, unsupported emphasis, repeated formulas and conversational residue. Can report problems only, propose a rewrite or edit a prose file. Assesses each finding in context, protects quotations and technical content and limits revision to two editorial passes. Matches punctuation in edited passages to the original.

## When to use it

Use it for text that sounds generic, pompous or repetitive when the underlying content is already available. Applies editorial judgment to phrasing; detector scores do not establish who wrote the text.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/avoid-ai-writing` in Claude Code or `$avoid-ai-writing` in Codex. Provide the text or file, reader, tone and parts to preserve. Specify whether you want findings only or a revision. Request an account of changes, checks performed and any limitations; do not use a score as proof of authorship.

## What it delivers

- Revised text or findings, depending on the mode
- Reasons for changes
- Preservation checks and verification limitations
